caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wall mirror with a dark brown wooden frame. The frame is beveled and features a slightly lighter inner border, while the top of the mirror casing is an ornate, arched crest that extends above the rectangular section. This crest is scalloped along its top edge, and in the center of the arch is a small, shield-shaped cutout or inlay. The main mirror is a pale blue tone, possibly reflecting some light or color, and has faint, vertical marks that suggest a soft reflection. The entire mirror is centered on a beige or light tan background, with a thin, hand-drawn border framing the image. Near the bottom right within the border, the name "FRANCIS BORELLI" is written in faint, capitalized letters.
title: Mirror
